hints.en: The starter code finds the opposite, the used ones.

hints.tr: Kümelere çevir ve farkını al: `sorted(set(granted) - set(used))`.
hints.en: Turn them into sets and take the difference: `sorted(set(granted) - set(used))`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def unused_permissions(granted, used):
    return sorted(set(granted) - set(used))

granted = ["crm:read", "crm:write", "invoices:read", "payments:approve"]
used = ["invoices:read", "crm:read", "payments:approve"]
print(unused_permissions(granted, used))
print(unused_permissions(["a"], []))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def unused_permissions(granted, used):
    return sorted(set(granted) - set(used))

granted = ["crm:read", "crm:write", "invoices:read", "payments:approve"]
used = ["invoices:read", "crm:read", "payments:approve"]
print(unused_permissions(granted, used))
print(unused_permissions(["a"], []))
```
